svg.text: Midday check: what changed since the 6:48 am scan, Saturday 21 November 2026
Checked about 11:30 am Eastern. Each fact is from a major outlet; links are on World Pulse. Four new stories, six updated.
NEW
Tuesday 17 Nov to now
Record flooding on Florida's Space Coast: St. Johns River above its 1953 record
More than 17 inches of rain since Tuesday in places. Rescues by Friday afternoon: about 120 in Brevard County and well over 150 in Volusia County.
Rockledge told west-side residents to be ready to leave. The river keeps rising for days and stays flooded into next week. Emergency covers 21 counties.
Warnings run from just south of Melbourne to Jacksonville: Palm Beach County is outside them. No deaths reported in the sources found.
UNPROVEN
Announced Friday
A proof of the Riemann Hypothesis?
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpoge says
he and Claude proved the 1859 prime-number
problem ($1 million prize). 17 million lines of
computer-checkable code; not yet checked by
other mathematicians. Clay Institute: still unsolved.
UPDATED
Saturday
Hormuz: three tankers hit Saturday
Two struck by projectiles leaving the Gulf
(stern, engine room), no casualties. Iran says a
third hit a mine and caught fire. Iran shows a
new two-missile underground launcher; Qatar
mediators visited Friday to test diplomacy.
UPDATED
Fri night to Sat
Ukraine and Poland
Missile strike on Kryvyi Rih: 2 killed (a boy of 7),
60 hurt; more rockets hit arriving rescuers.
Russian cargo ship on fire in the Gulf of Finland
after a drone hit. Rutte in Warsaw: "NATO will
defend every inch of Polish territory".
NEW
Overnight
Mexico captures "El Chapo Isidro"
Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, on the FBI's 10 most
wanted list, caught in Guasave, Sinaloa, with
US intelligence help. Gunfire and burning cars
followed, including at a baseball game.
NEW
Ended Saturday
UN killer robot talks: no binding rules
Geneva talks agreed only to keep working on a
possible deal until 2028. Activists blame Russia
and the US for blocking stronger wording.
UN chief Guterres wanted binding rules this year.
UPDATED
Week and weekend
Markets: the worst week since April 2025
S&P 500: seven straight down days, longest
since 2020. Anthropic fell 8.5% Friday.
Bitcoin as low as about $55,150 Saturday, then
about $57,900. Markets reopen Monday 9:30 am.
Sources: AP, News 6 (ClickOrlando), Latin Times, Coinpaper, Scientific American. Live: howkoz.github.io/world-pulse
